name: Ride Editor
tagline: Cleans up a driving-footage channel and holds every upload for your approval.
description: Housekeeping for a driving-footage channel: titles get rewritten to be searchable, playlists get a sensible order, and the raw miles get cut into highlight reels with thumbnails to match. Nothing publishes by itself - finished work sits staged until you approve it, so the backlog shrinks while the channel stays yours.
author: Fnjrockerstein
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
